title: OP-5 and OP-6: The Index Asymptotic n_min(p) and the Reachable Fraction, with Their Corrections
summary: Packages the two problems the open/ directory was created to settle. OP-5: n_min(p) = p/log 2 - 3/2 + O(1) and P_n = (n+3/2)log 2 + c/n + O(1/n^2), c = 3(log 2)^2 - (25/12)log 2, proved axiom-clean in Lean 4 + Mathlib. The recorded O(1/p) error is false; meta-theorem O11 proves an integer index cannot track an irrational affine function to O(1/p). The exact ceiling law fails first at a 451-digit p (1150 dps), and other moduli have slope 1/log 2, not 1/log q. OP-6: L(p) = p log p - (1 + log log 2)p + O(1), its 1/p coefficient a closed-form function of the ceiling error, not the constant formerly quoted.
recipe_md:
Run from the folder. `./check.sh --all` writes `.olean` files next to the Lean sources, so run it in a copy if the folder must stay clean.

```sh
./check.sh --all                        # expect 9/9 "[check] OK", exit 0 (about 17 min here; 5 min recorded)
python3 op05_nmin.py                    # expect exit 0; c_fit(last 4) = -0.002697584512195 vs c_pred -0.002697584411948
python3 op06_reachable_fraction.py      # expect exit 0; (L - p log p)/p -> -0.6334870794 at p = 1e6
python3 op06_ceiling_coefficient.py     # expect exit 0; "VERDICT: CONFIRMED", worst |p*R - c(e)| = 3.143e-07
python3 op09_moduli.py                  # expect exit 0; "VERDICT: CONFIRMED", spread [-1.4950409, -0.51322271]
python3 verify-006/op05_nmin_ceiling.py       # expect exit 0; 76 values tested, 0 mismatches
python3 verify-006/op05_nmin_ceiling_false.py # expect exit 0; "(CEIL) FAILS" at a 451-digit p, verified at 1150 dps
```

`python3 op09_moduli.py` prints `theta(p) - p/log 2 = 6.0` in its section 2; that is an artefact of the bisection direction as coded (F1 is increasing in n), not a failure of the stated law, which rests on sections 1 and 3.
